dedupe_keys.name: a comprehensive dataset of residential air conditioning prevalence in the continental united states

description: A Comprehensive Dataset of Residential Air Conditioning Prevalence in the Continental United States is a data set described in a peer-reviewed Scientific Data article written by Yoonjung Ahn et al. This dataset presents the most complete estimate of residential air conditioning (AC) prevalence across the continental United States. Using property-level data for over 103 million housing units from the Dewey database, we imputed and classified four AC types: central, other, evaporative cooler, and none, using XGBoost models optimized for performance. Coverage: national (US); published in 2025. Formats: TXT, ZIP, CSV. The data are held in Harvard Dataverse and reached through its DOI listed on this page; the paper's Data Records section names it. Size stated by the repository: 4825451. Access is free of charge and open according to the article. The licence is CC0-1.0, taken from DataCite rights of the deposit. Caveats: written from the Scientific Data article metadata (title, abstract, Data Records section) read on 2026-10-01; the data themselves were not opened or downloaded, so their contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support building-stock, asset and facility studies. Related records: none catalogued yet.
